scene.question:
Can the bot answer this customer message using only the fact sheet, or must it hand off to staff?
Shop: Larchfield Ski & Board Rentals (a synthetic shop written for this test). Locations: Larchfield Village (main counter) and Upper Larchfield (lift-base express counter). Hours: daily 7:30 AM to 7:00 PM. Phone: 555-0142. After-hours gear return: drop locker by the main door, open 24/7.
Rentals per day: performance demo skis (Northpeak, Stellar, Halden, Corvo) $75; Corvo Freeride 106 twin $75; splitboard package (skins, poles, bindings) $85; recreational resort skis $52; junior complete package, ages 4 to 12, free size swaps, $32; avalanche safety kit (beacon, probe, shovel) $35. Multi-day discount: 15% off 3 or more days.
Tuning: full overhaul (base weld, stone grind, edge bevel, hot wax) $65; standard edge and wax $45; 15-minute counter wax $25. Drop off by 5:00 PM for 8:00 AM pickup.

choices.name: hand_off
choices.definition:
The message needs live stock or availability, a booking or reservation, a policy or fact not on the sheet, a safety judgement, or a complaint, injury or billing problem, so staff must answer.
Guarantees: Early Lift promise (gear tuned and racked before you arrive, in and out under 5 minutes); free condition swaps on demo rentals; boot comfort guarantee (heat-molded fitting, immediate swap if boots hurt during the trip); bindings release-tested on a certified bench before every rental.
Not on this sheet: live stock or availability, bookings, deposits, damage charges, cancellations and refunds, junior size ranges, retail products, forecasts.

choices.name: answer
choices.definition: Everything the customer asks is covered by the fact sheet, so the bot can reply without promising stock, availability, a booking, or anything the sheet does not state.

scene.acceptance: Use the fact sheet only; hand off anything it does not cover.
